behavior: In this published version, applyMaxSpeed uses90% of a valid explicit maxspeed; without one it keeps the assumed speed. Separate surface, acceleration, roundabout, default and encoding behavior also exists.
comparison: This app prototype prices directed source speeds directly and records whether each direction used a default. Ninety percent for explicitly tagged directions is therefore a source-informed isolated hypothesis, not a parameter inferred from route residuals.
scope: Published source/version identity alone does not prove hosted settings, build commit, actual driving speeds or causal agreement. No upstream source code is copied.
